text:
zara: Quick sync / note for the migration guide: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) need explicit instructions for flipping host paths from /v1/ to /v2/ without breaking internal DNS or customers behind proxies.

ocean: Agree. We had one customer on an air-gapped install where redirects can't be relied on. Need a clear on-prem checklist.

lucas: checklist idea: (1) update client config templates; (2) update local reverse-proxy rules; (3) roll SDK patch to pinned versions; (4) provide back-compat shim instructions for 30d.

zara: exact. I'll add a "Private deployment" subsection in the migration playbook with those steps and sample reverse-proxy config.

ocean: sample nginx snippet would help integrators. Something like:

```
# nginx example for transparent redirect
location /v1/ {
  return 301 /v2/$request_uri;
}
# or proxy_pass preserving host for internal clients
location /v1/ {
  proxy_pass http://internal-backend/v2/;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
}
```

lucas: also call out KMS/HSM note: if customers have signed tokens or url signatures tied to v1 paths, provide example re-signing flow and sample token TTL recommendations.

zara: adding that. Also: model alias swaps are slightly different in Private because some customers pin model binaries. We'll add a mapping table but flag "on-prem action required" for aliases that need binary swaps.

ocean: for embeddings, include an explicit statement: if embedding dim changes, we must avoid mixing vectors. Suggest a migration strategy: dual-serving period where v2 emits new-dim vectors while v1-stored vectors are reprocessed asynchronously; show a flag-driven rollout.

lucas: will add a small rollout script example (bash) that toggles a feature-flag in the control plane to route X% traffic to v2 and shows reindex job invocation.

zara: docs-bot: can you link the PR and create the checklist issue?

docs-bot: created issue #639: "private-deploy migration checklist" and linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1667; added label "deprecation-private"

ocean: one more nuance: rate-limit and quota headers changed names from X-RateLimit-Remaining-v1 -> X-RateLimit-Remaining. Add a short compatibility table and a snippet showing how to read both header names during transition.

lucas: sample JS header read snippet: 
```
function getRemaining(res){
  return res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining') || res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining-v1') || 'unknown'
}
```

zara: sweet. Also include troubleshooting section for 403 errors that surfaced when customers hit signed-url mismatches after host path change. Provide curl examples to validate host and signature.

ocean: timeline: publish private-deploy migration appendix with the main migration page. We should coordinate with the Private deployment team; propose internal review in 3 business days.

zara: plan: open PR now, request reviews from @lucas @ocean and @platform-priv; after internal approval merge and publish. I'll schedule the announcement to partners separately.

docs-bot: PR #1667 created and assigned reviewers @lucas @ocean; scheduled review reminder in 48h.

lucas: I'll add a smoke test that runs the reverse-proxy config check in our CI for private docs examples. Also will flag any partner docs that hardcode endpoints.

ocean: thanks 39; ping here when PR is merged and I'll coordinate the platform release notes.
